profile.headline: Product-Focused Frontend Lead | AI-Assisted Development & Agentic Workflows | Vue, Nuxt & TypeScript | UX/UI, Architecture & Conversion Strategy
profile.summary:
I’m a product-focused frontend lead who enjoys turning thoughtful plans into reliable, intuitive web products.
My background is rooted in frontend development, UX/UI, and digital design, but my work extends into product strategy, system architecture, analytics, technical planning, mentoring, and AI-assisted development. I work most confidently with Vue, Nuxt, TypeScript, modern CSS, Tailwind, and Bootstrap, while also contributing to API integrations, authentication, testing, DevOps, and delivery workflows.

AI has transformed how I approach product development. I use Claude, GPT/Codex, and Devin Desktop daily across planning, documentation, implementation, testing, and review. I’ve helped lead the adoption of agentic workflows within my development team, focusing on strong foundations, clear guardrails, reusable skills, consistent standards, and project environments that are easy for others to understand and contribute to.

One of my favorite recent projects involved establishing a structured AI-assisted development environment for a major web feature spanning a Grails API and Vue frontend. Centralized documentation and planning, test-driven development, Git workflows, automation, and clear standards created a maintainable foundation that made the project easier for others to pick up and extend.

I also created an internal Python-based hub for creating, managing, and using reusable AI skills. The goal was to lower the barrier to entry and make shared AI capabilities accessible to both technical and nontechnical teammates.
I care deeply about quality. Features should work, interfaces should feel intuitive, and complexity should be justified. I value clean production environments, scalable processes, thoughtful contingency planning, and workflows designed to reduce inconsistencies.

I work closely with design, analytics, marketing, and development teams to prototype experiences, improve conversion paths, identify tracking opportunities, and translate business goals into practical product decisions. I see websites as more than interfaces—they are measurable tools for engagement and conversion.

I’m approachable, curious, and always willing to help when a project gets difficult. I enjoy mentoring developers, exploring emerging tools, and building systems that help the entire team work more effectively.

I’m open to the right opportunity where I can remain hands-on while contributing to frontend development, UX, architecture, agentic workflows, and product strategy.

positions.title: Lead Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Lead the frontend development and continued evolution of large-scale web products, contributing across implementation, UX/UI, product strategy, architecture, analytics, and technical planning.

• Build and improve applications using Vue, Nuxt, TypeScript, JavaScript, Sass, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, and component-based development practices.

• Use Claude, GPT/Codex, and Devin Desktop daily for planning, documentation, implementation, testing, review, and working across unfamiliar technologies.

• Help lead the adoption of agentic development workflows, establishing clear documentation, reusable skills, guardrails, testing standards, Git strategies, and automation.

• Created a structured AI-assisted development environment for a major web feature spanning a Grails API and Vue frontend. Centralized planning, test-driven development, automated workflows, and clear standards made the project easier to maintain, extend, and contribute to.

• Built an internal Python-based hub for creating, managing, and using reusable AI skills, making shared capabilities more accessible to technical and nontechnical teammates.

• Collaborate with design teams on wireframes, prototypes, design systems, component libraries, and intuitive user experiences.

• Partner with analytics and marketing teams to identify tracking opportunities, implement custom data capture, interpret user behavior, and support engagement and conversion goals.

• Contribute to system architecture, API integrations, authentication, automated testing, DevOps workflows, and technical recommendations.

• Mentor developers, share emerging AI practices, help solve difficult problems, and strengthen collaboration between design and development.

Additional experience includes REST APIs, GraphQL, JWT authentication, webhooks, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Docker, Node.js, PHP, WordPress, MODX, CrafterCMS, dotCMS, and Java-based systems.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description:
Designed and developed web experiences, marketing pages, and reusable frontend components while helping expand the team’s development capabilities and processes.

Worked across frontend development, responsive design, CMS implementation, analytics, and collaboration with creative, account, and development teams.

positions.title: Web Designer/ Developer
positions.description: Designed and developed websites and email marketing campaigns for a range of clients, combining frontend implementation with visual design and digital marketing support.

positions.title: App / Web Developer and Graphic Designer
positions.description: Designed and developed websites, mobile and tablet experiences, digital publications, and supporting visual materials. Provided broad technical and creative support across web, application, print, and digital projects.
